supportEnvelope.basis: Manually selected visible outer ground-support masonry/metal footing extrema. Includes compact entrance threshold. These are the placement-envelope support points, not claims of four visible physical rectangle corners. Rear point is hidden and inferred by parallelogram closure. Approximately +/-6 px.

W.basis: Visible straight ground-support edge running toward lower-right. Endpoints follow the outer building footing; approximate visual selection +/-6 px. Local roof details may differ and are not claimed to share a perfect physical camera.

D.basis: Visible ground-support edge running toward upper-right (D reported with increasing source x). Approximate endpoints +/-6 px; ground direction is calibrated rather than treating source prompt as measurement.

heightReference.basis: Same-source-x architectural main-wall ruler from ground support to main cornice, excluding HVAC/crown machinery. Visible architectural top; base may be locally occluded and projected onto the adjacent visible footing. Approximate +/-10 px; visual height reference, not physical storey count.

notes: Original RGBA PNG is copied byte-for-byte to source and runtime paths; no pixel edit, recoloring, alpha threshold, crop or mirroring was applied.
Crop is the half-open alpha>8 bounding box. Existing render-time low-alpha cache treatment may suppress fringe pixels; source alpha is preserved.
This is a native two-cell rectangular architecture, with a continuous joined body and separately generated wide/deep orientation. It is not a single-cell image stretched to a rectangular parcel.
Ground envelope drives centering and >=0.1-cell per-side clearance. Both actual support spans and their ratio must be checked, not merely footprint labels.
Direction/scale mapping is an image calibration approximation. Unmeasured roofs, hidden geometry and source perspective variation are not claimed to be a recovered exact orthographic camera.
